words.title: A New Chapter for Scott's
words.body:
After six years at Ballyhackamore Working Men’s Club, *Scott’s Jazz Club has found a new home at The Deer’s Head in Belfast city centre*.

The club had originally expected to pause shows until 2027 after leaving its East Belfast venue - but it will now return *this December*, months earlier than planned.
